meanings.en: the one that you like the least among a group
meanings.exampleEn: Maths was always my least favourite subject at school.
meanings.exampleTr: Matematik okulda her zaman en sevmediğim dersti.

meanings.en: to not include someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You can leave out the last question if you run out of time.
meanings.exampleTr: Zaman yetmezse son soruyu atlayabilirsin.

meanings.en: the process of using a court of law to settle a dispute
meanings.exampleEn: The company started legal proceedings against its former director.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket eski müdürüne karşı yasal işlem başlattı.

meanings.en: the quality of being reasonable, acceptable, or lawful
meanings.exampleEn: Many people questioned the legitimacy of the new government.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok kişi yeni hükümetin meşruiyetini sorguladı.

meanings.en: something you do for enjoyment in your free time
meanings.exampleEn: Reading and gardening are her favourite leisure activities.
meanings.exampleTr: Okumak ve bahçeyle uğraşmak onun en sevdiği boş zaman etkinlikleridir.

meanings.en: the quality of being too long, especially in time or words
meanings.exampleEn: The lengthiness of the report made it hard to read.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporun aşırı uzunluğu onu okumayı zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being kind or not strict in punishing someone
meanings.exampleEn: The judge showed leniency because it was the boy's first offence.
meanings.exampleTr: Yargıç çocuğun ilk suçu olduğu için hoşgörü gösterdi.

meanings.en: a person who holds the lease of a property; a tenant
meanings.exampleEn: The lessee is responsible for any damage to the apartment.
meanings.exampleTr: Kiracı, dairedeki herhangi bir hasardan sorumludur.

meanings.en: not as great in size, amount, or importance
meanings.exampleEn: They chose the lesser of two evils.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kötü seçenekten daha az kötü olanını seçtiler.

meanings.en: in order to prevent something bad from happening
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke quietly lest she wake the baby.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeği uyandırmasın diye alçak sesle konuştu.

meanings.en: to accidentally reveal a secret or piece of information
meanings.exampleEn: He let slip that they were planning a surprise party.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir sürpriz parti planladıklarını ağzından kaçırdı.

meanings.en: feeling tired and without energy or enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: The hot weather made everyone feel lethargic.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak hava herkesi halsiz hissettirdi.

meanings.en: in a tired way that shows no energy
meanings.exampleEn: He moved lethargically around the kitchen after the long night shift.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun gece vardiyasından sonra mutfakta halsizce dolandı.

meanings.en: calm and sensible, especially in a difficult situation
meanings.exampleEn: We need a level-headed person to lead the team through the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekibi krizden geçirecek soğukkanlı bir insana ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: humour or lack of seriousness, especially at an inappropriate time
meanings.exampleEn: A moment of levity helped ease the tension in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir anlık şakacılık odadaki gerginliği hafifletti.

meanings.en: legally responsible for something
meanings.exampleEn: The driver was held liable for the damage to the car.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürücü, arabadaki hasardan sorumlu tutuldu.

meanings.en: likely to do or experience something, usually unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: Roads are liable to freeze overnight in winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Yollar kışın gece boyunca donmaya eğilimlidir.

meanings.en: to make laws, systems, or attitudes less strict
meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to liberalize trade with neighbouring countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet komşu ülkelerle ticareti serbestleştirmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: a person who sets others free from control or oppression
meanings.exampleEn: The troops were welcomed as liberators by the local people.
meanings.exampleTr: Birlikler yerel halk tarafından kurtarıcı olarak karşılandı.

meanings.en: allowed by law
meanings.exampleEn: The company deals only in licit goods.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket yalnızca yasal mallarla iş yapar.

meanings.en: a military or police officer of middle rank, or a chief assistant
meanings.exampleEn: The lieutenant ordered his men to hold their position.
meanings.exampleTr: Teğmen adamlarına mevzilerini korumalarını emretti.

meanings.en: the number of years a person or thing is likely to live or last
meanings.exampleEn: Life expectancy has risen sharply over the past century.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşam beklentisi geçen yüzyılda keskin bir şekilde arttı.

meanings.tr: daha az sevmek, daha az beğenmek
meanings.en: to enjoy or approve of something to a smaller degree
meanings.exampleEn: I like this song, but I like it less than the last one.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu şarkıyı seviyorum ama öncekinden daha az seviyorum.

meanings.en: pleasant and easy to like
meanings.exampleEn: The new manager is friendly and very likeable.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni müdür arkadaş canlısı ve çok sevimli biri.

meanings.en: able to bend and move easily and gracefully
meanings.exampleEn: Dancers need to stay limber to avoid injuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçılar sakatlanmamak için esnek kalmalıdır.

meanings.en: to prepare your muscles for exercise by stretching
meanings.exampleEn: The athletes limber up before every race.
meanings.exampleTr: Sporcular her yarıştan önce ısınma hareketleri yapar.

meanings.en: without an end or limit
meanings.exampleEn: She seems to have limitless energy for her work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşi için sınırsız enerjiye sahip görünüyor.

meanings.en: the state of having no limits or end
meanings.exampleEn: The novel explores the limitlessness of human imagination.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, insan hayal gücünün sınırsızlığını inceliyor.

meanings.en: to form or arrange people or things in a row
meanings.exampleEn: The children lined up outside the classroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sınıfın önünde sıraya girdi.

meanings.en: to arrange for something to happen or be available
meanings.exampleEn: We've lined up several speakers for the conference.
meanings.exampleTr: Konferans için birkaç konuşmacı ayarladık.

meanings.tr: dinledi, kulak verdi (listen to fiilinin geçmiş hali)
meanings.en: past tense of 'listen to'; gave attention to a sound or person
meanings.exampleEn: We listened to music all evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün akşam müzik dinledik.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no energy or enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: She stared listlessly out of the window all afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün öğleden sonra pencereden isteksizce dışarı baktı.

meanings.en: to take a dispute to a court of law
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies chose to litigate rather than settle out of court.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirket, mahkeme dışında anlaşmak yerine dava açmayı seçti.

meanings.en: the quality of being full of energy and enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: The liveliness of the market attracts many tourists.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazarın canlılığı birçok turisti cezbediyor.

meanings.en: a room or space directly under the roof of a house, often used for storage
meanings.exampleEn: We keep our old furniture up in the loft.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski mobilyalarımızı çatı katında saklıyoruz.

meanings.en: a person who studies or is skilled in logic
meanings.exampleEn: As a logician, she could spot the flaw in any argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir mantıkçı olarak, herhangi bir argümandaki hatayı fark edebilirdi.

meanings.tr: zayıf ihtimal, uzak olasılık, riskli girişim
meanings.en: something that has only a small chance of succeeding
meanings.exampleEn: Applying for that job is a long shot, but it's worth a try.
meanings.exampleTr: O işe başvurmak zayıf bir ihtimal ama denemeye değer.

meanings.en: long life or long duration
meanings.exampleEn: A healthy diet is often linked to longevity.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlıklı bir beslenme genellikle uzun ömürlülükle ilişkilendirilir.

meanings.en: to take care of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Could you look after my dog while I'm away?
meanings.exampleTr: Ben yokken köpeğime bakabilir misin?

meanings.en: (of something bad) about to happen and worrying
meanings.exampleEn: With the deadline looming, the team worked through the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Son teslim tarihi yaklaşırken ekip gece boyunca çalıştı.

meanings.en: with one side lower or larger than the other; unbalanced
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a lopsided smile and shrugged.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir tarafa yatık bir gülümseme verdi ve omuz silkti.

meanings.en: a large number or amount of something
meanings.exampleEn: There were lots of people at the concert.
meanings.exampleTr: Konserde bir sürü insan vardı.

meanings.en: of low quality or a low level
meanings.exampleEn: The factory was fined for using low-grade materials.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika düşük kaliteli malzeme kullandığı için para cezasına çarptırıldı.

meanings.en: (of a building) having few storeys
meanings.exampleEn: They live in a quiet low-rise apartment block.
meanings.exampleTr: Sessiz, az katlı bir apartmanda yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: the social group with the lowest status and least money
meanings.exampleEn: The reforms were designed to help families from the lower class.
meanings.exampleTr: Reformlar alt sınıftan ailelere yardım etmek için tasarlandı.

meanings.tr: daha alt rütbeli, daha düşük kademeli
meanings.en: having a lower position or rank in an organization
meanings.exampleEn: The decision was made by senior staff, not lower-ranking employees.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, daha düşük kademeli çalışanlar tarafından değil, üst düzey personel tarafından verildi.

meanings.en: the state of being humble or of low rank or importance
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the lowliness of his origins, he rose to become a leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Mütevazı kökenine rağmen yükselip bir lider oldu.

meanings.en: clear and easy to understand
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a lucid explanation of the new policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politikayı açık ve anlaşılır bir şekilde açıkladı.

meanings.en: able to think clearly, especially during illness
meanings.exampleEn: The patient had a few lucid moments before falling asleep.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta uykuya dalmadan önce birkaç ayık, zihni açık an geçirdi.
